James and his team converted our basically unusable backyard into an oasis that our family loves to spend time in.

His team made sure we got everything done to our liking and we are so happy we committed to doing this project.

Highly recommend!

I don’t even know where to start to be honest. James Bryant and Fort Worth Pool are hands down the best people I have worked and interacted with in a long time.

The pool build was on schedule even during the rainy season and the communication was unreal.

My advice when using Fort Worth Pool is to listen to James throughout the design process. He has a vision unlike anyone I have ever met. Our pool design changed (for the better) several times and we could not be more thankful and happy with th

Fort Worth pools made my dream of a back yard come true.  James designed my pool package to bring my vision to life. This company has been very professional and addressed every question or concern no matter how insignificant they might seem to be.   All materials have been the best quality and the finished product is absolutely gorgeous.  I would personally recommend this company to anyone who is interested or considering building a backyard oasis.  James is the total package,  you are not just

After already interviewing/requesting quotes from 7 other pool companies, the 1st time my husband and I met James, we knew the research for our new pool was over. James not only could see our vision, he added to it. Better yet, he made it all come true and without cutting any corners. This was not my first pool build so I knew what to expect and what type of quality to look for. Fort Worth Pool exceeded all my expectations and made the process seamless. To me, communication is key, and not once

James and team exceeded our expectations.  We had a design/dream in mind and Fort Worth Pool made it a reality.  This was our second time building a pool and was such a pleasant experience.  We didn’t feel as if we were being upsold on every decision.  The team did a great job of communicating and working together during the entire process. James produces a great pool for a fair price.  There is no doubt I would use him in the future.

When we signed our contract with Ft Worth Pool they said 6-8 weeks.  We were very skeptical due to all the horror stories going around.  Well guess what?  We are 5 1/2 weeks in and my pool is filled and ready to enjoy. If you are looking for a hardworking group that deliverers then this is your guy!   Happy customer who got exactly what they asked for!  (We have not attended pool school yet, so it is a little dirty).

James was kind, professional, and knowledgeable. He was incredibly patient and accommodating with a couple of very picky clients 🤣. Seriously, our pool is gorgeous and we are thrilled with James and his team! (Photo of pool without landscaping - that’s coming soon! 😍) …

Fort Worth Pool is the best!! Just got my pool recently finished and my family and i Love it. James was wonderful along with his crew amazing communication 🥰 thank you james for Making our back yard beautiful!! …

James came to look at a specialty floor and a pergola for possible replacement.   He explained what I have and how to clean it up without having to replace it.  I appreciate that he didn't try to sell me on something new when my existing can easily be cleaned up and refreshed.  I definitely recommend James based on his honesty and business ethics.

I absolutely loved working with Fort Worth Pools! James is a stand up kind a guy! I would build another pool with him anytime!

Thanks,
Christy Wade
We love our new pool. James and team understands your vision and can bring it to life. We are really enjoying the pool with our kids and grandkids it is spectacular!

Great company! I cannot give them enough praise. We have a small backyard and thought we could never have a pool, so we had Fort Worth Pool come out and see what they could do. We are VERY happy with the result. The entire process was efficient and masterfully done. If you are thinking of having a pool built, Fort Worth Pool is definitely the one to call.

James at Fort Worth pools promised and delivered at a great price and we are extremely pleased with the end result!! From pool construction to landscaping they do it all in a timely manor even during our wet weather!!

James and Fort Worth Pool did a great job on our project...it was not just the pool, but tied in external concrete work, landscaping, and drainage. No project is perfect, or simple, and James and team worked to navigate any issues and with good communication at every turn. Working in a client services industry, I value high communication and his team did a great job all the way. Highly recommend!

OUTSTANDING! All around very pleased and so happy we went with Fort Worth Pool for our new pool. There are many choices out there but my wife and I knew from the minute we met James that this was going to be the team that installed our future pool. His team is top notch, caring, professional and went the extra mile from start to finish. You will be very pleased if you choose Fort Worth Pool for your next pool, irrigation or landscaping needs. HIGHLY RECOMMEND and will use them again!
Great company, James and his team do excellent work from start to finish. If you’re looking for a pool, outdoor space or just a landscape upgrade definitely give these guys a call!

James is an amazing business man!  He’s quick to respond, has a great eye for designing projects that are beautiful and functional, and is trustworthy.  We will definitely work with him again in the future!

They estimator/Sales guy is a joke. I knew immediately this company didn't know what they were doing. I feel bad for the people they screwed over and for those that weren't aware that they paid goo
d money for a substandard pool install. Companies like these need to be given criminal cases.
Fort Worth Pool is by far best customer service. Very beautiful work at a reasonable price.
Great Company, backed by hard working and honest local  ownership!
